column5: Tooltip (com.mendix.widget.web.tooltip.Tooltip, Marketplace 119160, current 1.5.1, reactReady)
column9: Docs: 'This widget is deprecated. For an alternative, see the Tooltip widget.' New widget wraps the trigger content in a region instead of targeting a class name, so this is a manual re-model.

column5: Skeleton (Marketplace 119807) or In View Content Renderer (218777); or out-of-the-box list view + nanoflow + microflow
column9: README: 'This widget is no longer working' and it names these alternatives, which both need a 'loading done' boolean. React readiness of the two widgets is not confirmed. The React client already renders the page incrementally.

column5: Dropdown Container (mendix.dropdowncontainer.DropdownContainer, pluggable, Marketplace 111568); Mendix-supported alternative: Pop-up Menu (com.mendix.widget.web.popupmenu.PopupMenu, 4.3.1, reactReady)
column9: README tells you to move to Dropdown Container. That widget is pluggable but was built with old pluggable-widgets-tools, and the React client needs tools 9.4.1 or later, so its React support is unconfirmed. The Pop-up Menu option is my inference.

column5: Data Grid 2 / Gallery built-in filter widgets (Data Widgets 116540: text/number/date/dropdown filter)
column9: README: on 9.6+ it needs a Dojo widget inside list views to force Dojo mode, so it is Dojo-only. Moving to the Data Widgets filters comes from a community answer, not Mendix docs. Any Search / Active Filters have no 1:1 equivalent.

column5: HTML Element (com.mendix.widget.web.htmlelement.HTMLElement, Marketplace 204843, 1.2.12) for HTML; JavaScript actions called from a nanoflow, triggered by the Events widget, for JS
column9: Named in the React migration guide. HTML Element is a Marketplace widget that starter apps ship with. Classify it as platform if the toolkit treats it as built in. HTMLSnippet 4.x wraps its output in .widget-events with flex 1 1 auto, which takes row space in a flex row (LAY-12); check the row on the layout rung. Related React rule (LAY-12): .mx-scrollcontainer-center .mx-layoutgrid .mx-layoutgrid-fluid {padding:0} also zeroes grids that were not nested on Dojo, because React wraps the page in an extra scroll container region; theme_clash lists such rules as react-wrapper.
Searched Mendix docs, web-widgets and the web. Candidates: ActionByKeys (GDK, Marketplace 111677) and SmartClick Actions (AuraQ, 241976); React readiness unconfirmed for both.

column5: Events (com.mendix.widget.web.events.Events, Marketplace 224259, 1.3.1, reactReady), using Delay/Repeat
column9: Docs mark it deprecated: 'use the Events widget'.
Deprecated hybrid/Cordova widget; docs name no replacement. The real path is a move to PWA or native apps, not a widget swap.

column7: https://www.mendix.com/?p=30400 (blog on the jQuery/Dojo Notification widget)
column9: No repo or replacement found. Candidates: Feedback toast notification (111533, says it is React-based), Toastr Notifications (118651), SweetAlert2 (118120); none confirmed for the React client.

column5: Pusher module v4.0.0 adds a new React widget com.mendix.widget.web.pusher.Pusher; legacy widget kept
column9: Docs: 'Versions below v4 do not support React client apps.' Both widgets can run side by side during migration. The widget id changes, so the widget must be swapped on each page.

column5: Conditional visibility 'Based on expression' (common widget properties)
column9: Widget computes visibility in a microflow. Platform needs an expression, or a calculated or non-persistent boolean attribute filled by the microflow. My mapping, not a docs statement.

column5: Slide Menu (mendix.slidemenu.SlideMenu, Marketplace 214968, 3.1.1, pluggable)
column9: README: 'a React-based replacement for the Dojo-based Slide in Slide out widget' (Marketplace 17847). Built with pluggable-widgets-tools 10.21. Min Mendix version not stated.

column5: Mendix Feedback Module (Marketplace 205506): snippet FeedbackModule.FeedbackWidget, on-click Show page FeedbackModule.ShareFeedback
column9: Named in the React guide. Docs also say every Feedback widget below 8.4.0 has been disabled since 2022-10-01, so 8.3.4 is already dead in Dojo too.

column5: Nanoflow Commons 'Open URL' JavaScript action called from a nanoflow, e.g. via the Events widget
column9: Community answers point to the Nanoflow Commons Open URL action; Nanoflow Commons is on the Mendix Marketplace React status page. A different URL Redirector listing (118716, v1.0.1, Mx 9.10) exists; its React status is unconfirmed.

column5: Charts 4.0.0+ (same Marketplace component 105695; current 6.3.2); new ids com.mendix.widget.web.<areachart|barchart|bubblechart|columnchart|heatmap|linechart|piechart|timeseries>.<Name>
column9: CHANGELOG 4.0.0: 'removed all deprecated chart widgets ... you must manually replace them with new ones'. The ids change and the configuration is re-modeled.

column5: File Uploader (com.mendix.widget.web.fileuploader.FileUploader, Mendix-supported module, 2.5.0)
column9: File Uploader does the same drag-and-drop multi-file upload. No source names it as the FileDropper replacement. It brings its own domain model (FileUploader.FileUploadContext).

column5: Image (com.mendix.widget.web.image.Image, Marketplace 118579, 1.6.1, reactReady), with On click type = Enlarge
column9: The React guide names Image as the replacement for the core image widgets, not for this custom widget. Feature mapping (URL/attribute source, enlarge) is mine.

column5: Gallery (com.mendix.widget.web.gallery.Gallery) plus Data Widgets filters and Drop-down sort (Data Widgets 116540)
column9: Custom widget ids (not pluggable). Community: List View / List View Controls are deprecated in favour of Gallery. Gallery filters are less rich (no reference dropdown filter).

Community: no longer supported on 10.24+. Candidates: Tree Node (single level per widget, nestable) or React Complex Tree (Marketplace 217986); neither is a tree-table, and React status is unconfirmed for 217986.

column5: Rich Text, same widget id com.mendix.widget.custom.richtext.RichText (Marketplace 74889), current 5.1.0, reactReady; engines changed at 2.0 (CKEditor4), 3.0 (TinyMCE) and 4.0 (Quill v2)
column9: Same id, so it upgrades in place, but every major is a breaking configuration change. I did not confirm which exact version first became pluggable.

column5: Signature 2.0.0+ (current 2.1.0), new id com.mendix.widget.web.signature.Signature, Marketplace 107984
column9: CHANGELOG 2.0.0: 'Migrated from Custom Widget (v1.x) to Pluggable'. The id and mpk name change, so the old Signature.mpk must be removed by hand.

column9: No source names Tree Node as the successor. Tree Node nests one level per widget, plus a self-reference recursive mode.

column5: JavaScriptSnippet pluggable rebuild (incentro.javascriptsnippet.JavaScriptSnippet, 2.2.2); or the platform route: JavaScript action + nanoflow + Events, as the React guide advises for JS snippets
column9: The pluggable rebuild uses a different id and I could not confirm it is the same Marketplace listing (43096). Code that touches the DOM or dojo needs a rewrite either way.

column5: Image widget (com.mendix.widget.web.image.Image, Marketplace 118579); right-click > Convert to Image; Studio Pro 11.4+: batch conversion (right-click > Convert all)
column9: Forms$ImageViewer is the storage alias of the dynamic image in the model SDK.

column5: Image widget; right-click > Convert to Image; Studio Pro 11.4+: batch conversion (right-click > Convert all); CARRY OVER the width and height unit: Auto stays auto, pixels stay pixels, percentage stays percentage (a conversion that maps Auto to percentage makes every image grow to its container's width). Check after converting; fix with mxcli: ALTER PAGE M.P { set (WidthUnit: auto) on <widget>; } (HeightUnit the same), then mx update-widgets
column9: Class placement (LAY-11): the classes now land on the wrapper div.mx-image-viewer, not on the img, so theme height or padding rules written for the img leave it overflowing. Fix in the theme: .mx-image-viewer.mx-image-viewer-responsive > img, .mx-image-viewer > img {max-width:100%; max-height:100%} (two classes are needed: the widget's own CSS `.mx-image-viewer-responsive img {max-height:none; max-width:none}` loads after the theme and wins over the single-class rule).

column5: Combo box (Marketplace 219304); right-click > Convert to combo box; Studio Pro 11.4+: batch conversion (right-click > Convert all)
column9: Combo box 2.x layout (LAY-10): the input container has min-width 135px and the placeholder is in the flow, not position absolute, so theme left/top rules on .widget-combobox-placeholder-text misplace it. Fix in the theme: placeholder position absolute; min-width 0 where the old control was narrower.
